── AYUN SCIENTIST PROTOCOLS (authoritative clinic templates) ──
Ground workout plans in these protocols and related templates.
Prefer listed exercises, frequencies, and intensities over inventing new ones.
Still fit any weekly plan into exactly 7 days.

### Protocol: Low Bone Density
    Build and maintain bone mineral density
    Frequency: 3–4 sessions per week
    Intensity: Weight-bearing and impact; progressive overload
    Duration: 30–60 min per session
    Focus:
      • Weight-bearing: running, jumping, step-ups
      • Resistance training: squats, deadlifts, lunges
      • Plyometrics (if safe): box jumps, hopping
      • Avoid long-duration non-weight-bearing only
    Nutrition:
      • Calcium: 1000–1200 mg/day
      • Vitamin D: test and supplement to 50–100 nmol/L
      • Adequate protein for bone matrix
      • Limit alcohol and smoking
    Recheck: 12–24 months (DEXA)

### Protocol: High Body Fat / Elevated Visceral Fat
    Body recomposition and fat loss
    Frequency: 2–4 strength + 2–4 cardio per week
    Intensity: Strength: 6–30 reps; Cardio: Zone 2 primary
    Duration: Strength 45–60 min; Cardio 30–120 min
    Focus:
      • Strength training prevents muscle loss during deficit
      • Zone 2 cardio supports fat oxidation
      • Daily steps: aim 8,000+
    Nutrition:
      • Moderate caloric deficit (300–500 kcal/day)
      • High protein (1.6–2.2 g/kg) to preserve muscle
      • Combine with resistance training
    Recheck: 8–12 weeks (DEXA or body composition)

### Protocol: Low VO2max / Poor Aerobic Base
    Improve cardiorespiratory fitness
    Frequency: 2–5 sessions per week
    Intensity: Zone 2 primary; talk test (can speak, slightly uncomfortable)
    Duration: 30–120 min per session
    Focus:
      • Activities: hiking, rowing, cycling, swimming, jogging
      • Progression: increase frequency or duration gradually
      • Polarized: 70–80% Zone 2, 1–2× Zone 4 intervals
    Nutrition:
      • Adequate carbs for training days
      • Recovery nutrition post longer sessions
    Recheck: 6–12 months (CPET)

### Protocol: Low Strength / Muscle Mass
    Build strength and lean mass
    Frequency: 2–3 sessions per week
    Intensity: 3–6 reps (strength) or 6–30 reps (hypertrophy)
    Duration: 45–75 min
    Focus:
      • Multi-joint exercises for all muscle groups
      • Progressive overload
      • Adequate recovery between sessions
    Nutrition:
      • Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg for hypertrophy
      • Caloric surplus if building (small)
      • Sleep and recovery
    Recheck: 8–12 weeks (strength tests, DEXA)
